info.name: Loan Platform API
info.description:
Requests and tests for the Loan Platform REST API.

Start the database and the application first (see README.md), then run the folders in order from top to bottom: later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

File uploads: in the Postman app, select the files from the postman/files folder for the three upload requests in the 'Documents' folder and the one in the 'Decisions' folder.
